_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

observations.basis: observations reviewed, the results table of the October 19th briefing

notices.basis: courtesy notices, the results table of the October 19th briefing

inspections.basis: field inspections, the results table of the October 19th briefing

corrections.basis: voluntary corrections, the results table of the October 19th briefing

abatements.basis: direct abatements, the results table of the October 19th briefing

enforcement.basis: formal enforcement, the results table of the October 19th briefing

observations_px.basis: computed: observations reviewed times 900 over observations reviewed, the px length at one scale, to one decimal

notices_px.basis: computed: courtesy notices times 900 over observations reviewed, the px length at one scale, to one decimal

inspections_px.basis: computed: field inspections times 900 over observations reviewed, the px length at one scale, to one decimal

corrections_px.basis: computed: voluntary corrections times 900 over observations reviewed, the px length at one scale, to one decimal

abatements_px.basis: computed: direct abatements times 900 over observations reviewed, the px length at one scale, to one decimal

enforcement_px.basis: computed: formal enforcement times 900 over observations reviewed, the px length at one scale, to one decimal

observations_m.basis: computed: observations reviewed times 8.4 m over observations reviewed, the limb length in metres at one scale, to the millimetre

notices_m.basis: computed: courtesy notices times 8.4 m over observations reviewed, the limb length in metres at one scale, to the millimetre

inspections_m.basis: computed: field inspections times 8.4 m over observations reviewed, the limb length in metres at one scale, to the millimetre

corrections_m.basis: computed: voluntary corrections times 8.4 m over observations reviewed, the limb length in metres at one scale, to the millimetre

abatements_m.basis: computed: direct abatements times 8.4 m over observations reviewed, the limb length in metres at one scale, to the millimetre

enforcement_m.basis: computed: formal enforcement times 8.4 m over observations reviewed, the limb length in metres at one scale, to the millimetre

trucks.basis: Sanitation brush collection vehicles carrying cameras, October 19th briefing

cameras_per_truck.basis: cameras per vehicle, the April 10th memo

cameras_fleet.basis: computed: vehicles times cameras per vehicle

cost_year.basis: contract cost per year, December 9th briefing

notice_days.basis: days of written notice to end the contract, December 9th briefing

pile_yd3.basis: cubic yards a monthly brush pickup may reach, October 19th briefing

pile_m3.basis: computed: cubic yards times 0.764555, to two decimals

pile_len_m.basis: computed: the windrow length whose half ellipse section 1.2 m high by 2.0 m deep holds pile_m3, to two decimals

proactive_pct.basis: percent proactive as the slide prints it, with no stated base

reactive_pct.basis: percent reactive as the slide prints it, with no stated base
